operational_wall_interval.caveat: Includes initial pilot, launch/build/gating intervals, startup and scheduling; eight-worker wall is not per-case latency. Completion audit/feature-readiness verification occurs afterward.

case_extraction_seconds.definition: Saved torch.cuda.synchronize-bracketed elapsed GPU extraction operation, not CUDA-event kernel-utilization time and not full new-input latency.

limitations: Summed case/worker/container spans overlap and must not be added together.

controller_to_provider_stop.caveat: Not the sum of parallel worker work or a per-arm/new-case inference benchmark.

sequence_assessment_and_repeats.remote_worker_seconds_exclude: Lost/preempted attempt work and startup/idle allowances; remote calls already contribute to recorded member timing, so do not add both sums.

complementarity.caveat: Member tables and stored timing may include safe cache reuse; this logical total and its recorded timing sum are not a measured count/work sum of newly executed calls.

embedding_locked_repeats.concurrent_work: Overlaps three-worker complementarity assessment; not an isolated speed benchmark.

local_training_and_reporting.training_timing_definition: Recorded fit_seconds are caller-measured fitting spans and may include scaling, early stopping and held prediction depending on procedure; they are neither CPU utilization seconds nor isolated inference latency.

completed_timing_phase.timing_scope: One predeclared first cell in each regime; held outcomes not read for this summary.

limitations: Frozen total-fit graph is planned scope, not a completed count.
Only completed immutable timing-phase evidence is included; active remaining-stage status/results are not read.
No final actual cost/runtime estimate or scaling extrapolation is supplied here.
Locked transfer repeats are outside the frozen assessment graph.

interpretation: Runtime accounting includes startup/idle allowances and sequence lost-attempt reserves; full $2 engineering allowance remains retained rather than claimed spent.

Provider metering can lag. The monthly before/after account delta and hourly named-app totals use different snapshots and do not exactly reconcile; their difference is not assigned to an experiment without evidence.
This is not a final provider invoice or live remaining-credit balance. No unused allocation is transferred to another scope. Retained-volume storage remains separate.
Local-only supervised assessment is active; transfer and independent confirmation are incomplete.

added_inference_cost_context.shared_cache_reuse: Frozen representations share a single extracted native-interface cache; fitting additional heads does not rerun that completed extraction.

head_recipe_workload.ridge: One deterministic fitted head per selected final fold recipe.
head_recipe_workload.embedding_mlp: 30 final members per selected final fold recipe (five stopping folds x six seeds).
head_recipe_workload.original_reference_mlp: 30 final members per selected final fold recipe (five stopping folds x two encodings x three seeds).

added_inference_cost_context.training_vs_inference: Nested selection, stopping/refits, clean stacking and execution repeats measure model training/assessment work. Head member counts describe model operations, but no independent serving/prediction-only wall timing was recorded.
added_inference_cost_context.gpu_extract_scope: Extraction stops after frozen trunk; recorded production receipts have no coordinate diffusion/confidence/distogram heads. Extraction timing therefore is not full Boltz coordinate-generation cost.
added_inference_cost_context.marginal_new_input_cost: Unknown: existing cached MSA/checkpoint/preprocessed input route, reused batch startup, compact feature load and new sequence preprocessing are not a new-input end-to-end benchmark.

explicit_exclusions: Retained-volume storage, egress and any unrelated account usage are not priced as experiment compute.
New-input MSA search/generation and full coordinate-production runtime are excluded; production used existing MSA cache and trunk-only extraction.
Parallel wall intervals and summed work overlap; do not add them or label amortized wall as individual latency.
Recorded member fit_seconds can include preprocessing, scaling/early stopping/prediction and cache reuse; not isolated inference latency or hardware utilization.
Engineering allowance retained in total is not a claim that the full allowance was spent.
Provider snapshots may lag and differently timed account/app metering do not reconcile exactly; no final invoice or live credit balance is inferred.
No per-arm allocation of the shared extraction charge or cloud sequence charge is invented.
Active transfer final actual cost/runtime and held outcome scores are excluded.
No new fits, GPU/cloud calls, provider refresh, raw downloads, inference benchmark or original-test rescoring were performed to create this summary.
